# round — horo position 5 (the ring breathes)

`round` is the **completing turn** of the [[horo]] ring — digit `5`, the next fold of the [[coil]] on the **return** arc (`7 → 14 ⇒ 5`). The flow comes to rest: inventory *delivered*, the counterpart *received*, the two sides nearing [[balance]] ([[reconcile]] matches them here). It is the breath of the ring before it closes — the [[sequence]] anchor `5` ([[admin]], the surface that binds the cycle). Between [[descent]] and [[unity]]; the last position before the ring closes.

**Law — [[law]]: [[horo]] position 5 — the completing turn that brings a returning flow to rest (delivered · received), the two sides nearing [[balance]]; the last position before the ring closes at [[unity]].**
